title: The Signal of Kepler Reach
author: Odile Delacroix
blurb: Kestrel Zhou, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
